- If our most recent Type II doesn't cover the HelioPay requested window, provide a bridge letter that explains the covered period and any interim controls

2) Any specific redaction rules (IP, internal emails)?

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request and scope clarification

Hi Elena — looping in from Security & Compliance. Short answers up front:  

- Our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31 (opinion date 2024-02-15). The report file name is "Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023_Report.pdf."
- If your auditor requires coverage that extends past 2023-12-31 into 2024 (or later), we provide a bridge letter outlining interim controls and any material changes. The bridge letter can be signed by our VP of Security.

What we typically share as a minimal intake package: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF, redacted)
- Bridge letter (if needed) — short (1 page) summary of what is covered and the period gap
- Control owner list (name, role, email) for controls commonly assessed (incident response, change mgmt, access mgmt)
- Log retention summary (where logs are retained, retention periods by data class)
- Contact for evidence requests during the audit (security@redwood.com)

Recommended delivery methods: secure Box folder (preferred), SFTP, or Okta/Workshare dropbox for signed artifacts. We can also provide a DocuSign-signed PDF. For HelioPay specifically, I'll prepare the minimal package and upload to the Box link Sean shared. Expect the upload by 2028-04-09 14:00 PDT.

Small note on redaction: we redact third-party vendor contracts and internal employee PII by default. If your auditor needs unredacted sections we'll run that through a reviewer queue (takes longer).

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023_Report.pdf (pdf), Redwood_Bridge_Letter_template.docx (docx)

Thanks — Marissa
